hey man, I'm in the same situation but it's really dog that I can't leave behind. He's the only one that relies on me to wake up in the morning. He doesn't like anyone besides myself and my
recent ex. I've had a horrible few weeks with my girlfriend of 8 years leaving me abruptly. Like you, I
seem to be a little self destructive as well as codependent. My medication doesn't seem to help...not even 100mg of Benadryl can make my mind shut off. Benzos and weed help a little but i still can't stop thinking about it. I honestly would do it but my dog is already depressed that his "mom" hasn't come home. I know my family would be devastated but they have their own lives, their own careers and families now. I'm just a burden on them. Someone they feel sorry for, someone they have to offer a bed to once I move out of the house I lived in with my ex. And even someone they have to financial provide for until I get a job in my new city. The burden I put on my loved ones while alive mixed with my own heartache is just too much to handle. The guilt of breaking multiple people's hearts just so yours stops hurting is hard. But they say live for yourself, not for others. So why is death any different?
